brief:
An inquest into the deaths of three British aid workers killed in Gaza may call Israeli and UK military commanders to testify, a lawyer told a hearing, the Guardian reported. Families of the deceased want to establish whether British-made weaponry caused the deaths, the lawyer said.

The workers died when their aid vehicles came under fire in Gaza. The inquiry will determine what evidence is needed to answer the families' questions about the circumstances and weapons involved in the deaths.
